summary_en: The caller initiated the call by expressing extreme frustration and verbally attacking the agent, accusing the company of being a fraud and using derogatory language. The agent apologized for the perceived inconvenience and attempted to de-escalate the situation by asking how they could assist. The caller remained hostile, refused any further assistance, and did not engage with any offers or explanations. The call ended abruptly without any resolution or agreed next steps.
objections: Caller expressed severe anger and accused the company of being fraudulent.
